BODY: All is ready for tonight. The back stair is unwatched.
Is the King gone to hunt?
At first light. He will not return before dusk.
I will come when the household sleeps. Say nothing to the other ladies.
Burn these messages after. Promise me.
I promise. A token, until tonight.
Gentlemen, the valuations are in. Glastonbury is a goldmine.
Literally. The plate alone runs to thousands of ounces.
Let us proceed carefully. The North is restless about the smaller houses.
Proceed. And let us not lose our heads over the paperwork.
Noted, Your Majesty. I will send the schedule by this afternoon.
Tiltyard at noon? Bring the new Italian armour.
I will be there. Loser buys the wine.
You always say that and never lose.
